objective: Independent cross-provider review of the final Claude-authored revision of the playable 3D portfolio game (Milestones 1 to 5): shell and entry transition, physics and locomotion, animator and clips, follow camera and body clearance, campus world and textures (including the texture worker and shader warm-up), interactions and panels, challenge and versioned progress, touch controls, inert page and failure handling, and the tests. Judge correctness, robustness, resource cleanup, accessibility, maintainability and test honesty.
acceptanceCriteria: The diff between baseRef and headRef was inspected in full and every finding cites a file and line in that diff.
Every requiredChecks command was executed verbatim in the working copy and its real exit code and output excerpt are recorded in crossReview.checksRun.

The hero is unchanged except the permitted changes (public/avatar.glb clothing bake, the shared clothing mechanism call in components/avatar/Avatar.tsx, and the Play entry and no-WebGL guard in components/avatar/TalkingAvatar.tsx); lib/persona.ts, data/index.ts and app/api are untouched; game code is not imported into the initial portfolio bundle (ADR-006 boundary).

Tests for physics, camera and body clearance, challenge and progress (ADR-005 fallbacks), touch controls, inert page and no-WebGL assert behaviour that could fail (no end-state-only or always-true assertions), and the M1 cross-review findings (camera minimum distance on pull-in, offline build font) are verified fixed.

Any correctness, robustness, resource-leak (listeners, timers, workers, GPU objects, Rapier objects), accessibility or maintainability defect in the game code is reported as a finding with severity; the owner-accepted known limitations (toe up to about 6 cm into props in corners, faint interior wall streaks, cold-load gain about 600 ms of 1.1 s, terminal-style dialog wording, no sound or quality presets) are not findings.
constraints: Read-only: do not modify, stage, commit, stash or reset anything; the working copy is snapshotted and fingerprinted.
Run checks exactly as listed; do not substitute shorter commands. Use Node 22 if an nvm switch is needed.
Report verdict not-applicable; put the review outcome in crossReview.verdict (approved or changes-requested).
